title: Question on the page "infiniteHits"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[infiniteHits](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/infiniteHits.html)".

Is there a way to have the show more button disappear when results are exhausted? Not seeing a class or status to target that with CSS or other.
